title: Pi LaTeX Workbench proposed contract
description: Design contracts, not a running service. Semantic checks are specified separately.

releaseId.description: package an already-frozen release (host-approved digest binds to it); when omitted, a fresh release is frozen for the input tuple

argvTemplate.description: Fixed argv; the only placeholders are {entry} and {outdir} and are substituted by the runner, never by project or model input.

envAllowlist.description: Environment variable names the runner may set from its own fixed values. Inherited variables not listed here are stripped.
